summary: End-to-end ML platforms handle the full lifecycle—data prep, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring—at scale, unlike a hosted model API where you simply call a pre-built model. You need a platform like SageMaker, Vertex AI, or Databricks when you're building or customizing your own models, need reproducible pipelines, governance, and infrastructure control; a model API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock) is enough when you just want inference on an existing foundation model. The market is increasingly split between hyperscaler-native suites (AWS, Google, Azure), open/multi-cloud platforms (Databricks, W&B), and newer serverless/GenAI-focused compute layers (Modal, Mosaic AI).

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/storage/endpoint hour; no upfront fee, with savings plans available
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams wanting the deepest, most service-rich MLOps and pipeline/CI-CD depth

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per node/compute hour, prediction, and feature-serving; usage-based
platforms.best_for: Teams prioritizing real-time feature serving, AutoML, and native access to Google foundation models

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/VM hour; no surcharge over underlying Azure compute
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing governance and responsible-AI tooling

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBUs plus underlying cloud compute; subscription tiers
platforms.best_for: Unified data + ML teams wanting a multi-cloud lakehouse with open-source MLflow and GenAI tooling

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free for individuals; per-seat/usage-based team and enterprise tiers
platforms.best_for: ML/DL research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and model lineage

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated ML and governance for business analysts and data science teams

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source free core; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and H2O AI Cloud
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting open-source + automated ML with strong interpretability

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second serverless compute (CPU/GPU usage-based); free starter credits
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting code-first serverless GPU compute for training and deploying models without managing infra

platforms.name: Amazon Bedrock
platforms.best_for: AWS teams building generative-AI apps on managed foundation models with fine-tuning and RAG

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free tier; usage-based inference endpoints and Pro/Enterprise subscriptions
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source models who need hosting, fine-tuning, and managed inference
